claim: § Rank as a measured property: "the rank N itself is a measured quantity" — a harmonic tone fits rank 1, a stiff string or bell needs N >= 2; § The synth as its own oscilloscope: watch the lattice fit converge, then play the synth with that lattice.

pieces.what: Feed it a harmonic tone, then a stretched piano partial set, then a bell; the fitter finds the fewest generators and shows the rank settle, with residual energy per rank
pieces.walks_up_from: one sine, rank 1 with no residual

pieces.section: The synth as its own oscilloscope
pieces.what: Round trip: analyse a recorded note, show the fitted generators on a torus, and play the resynthesis beside the original
